author: Unity
description:
Discover how Unity 7 introduces ECS for All, bridging the gap between classic GameObjects and data-oriented design.

In Unity 7, every GameObject is also an entity, and entity-component-system (ECS) transforms are GameObject transforms. Your projects gain performance by default as engine systems move to ECS, letting you tap into raw speed exactly where you need it without complex synchronization.

Backed by a reworked serialization system and native Inspector support, you can now add real Entity data directly to GameObjects - with custom editors, undo, and multi-object editing working out of the box.

Focus on building the experience first, and optimize for speed when you’re ready.

🔗 Learn more about ECS: https://on.unity.com/4iHiFPL
